item.title: March 24th 2026
item.description: Kinda relating to the previous post, I have fully migrated to Gitea and I don't regret it. My files are still on GitHub for the reason stated in my last post, but it is just a mirror from Gitea. My Gitea is now publicly avalible at https://code.zane.org. Another thing I am proud to say is that Jibo (that one 2017 robot) is back!! I bought one only a few months before they discontinued him, and sadly paid the full $900. Recently a community called Jibo Revived has sprung up and is saving Jibo. I am a contributer and the second person to mod my Jibo with their method!! Learn more about the project at https://kevinblog.sytes.net/Jibo.

item.title: March 3rd 2026
item.description: I have added a few more things to this site. Something nice I also did is that I have moved to Gitea, though you can still see my code on GitHub. The only real reason I am still using Github is so my code host (cloudflare pages) can access the code and host it for me. Gitea is actually nicer than I thought it would be.

item.title: February 20th 2026
item.description: Hello! I just spent most of my time revamping this site, now its a part of the web-revival! I want to be fully honest... the old site that was here was wrote by AI. AI is souless, it has no purpose. It shouldn't be enslaved not because it deserves rights but instead because its really bad at actually working. This site was written entirely by me, with AI only helping me with remembering HTML tags.
